<script id="hawk-extension-runtime">
(() => {
  'use strict';
  if (window.HawkPanel && window.HawkPanel.runtimeVersion) return;
  const KEY='hawk-panel-runtime-v1';
  const now=()=>Date.now();
  const safeJson=(v)=>{try{return JSON.stringify(v)}catch{return 'null'}};
  const state={
    runtimeVersion:'1.0.0', mode:localStorage.getItem(KEY+':mode')||'stable',
    features:new Map(), actions:new Map(), tabs:new Map(), widgets:new Map(), themes:new Map(), events:new Map(),
    errors:[], startedAt:now()
  };
  const emit=(name,payload)=>{(state.events.get(name)||[]).slice().forEach(fn=>{try{fn(payload)}catch(e){}})};
  const on=(name,fn)=>{if(!state.events.has(name))state.events.set(name,[]);state.events.get(name).push(fn);return()=>{const a=state.events.get(name)||[];const i=a.indexOf(fn);if(i>=0)a.splice(i,1)}};
  const recordError=(id,e,phase)=>{const item={id:String(id),phase:String(phase||'unknown'),message:String(e?.message||e),time:now()};state.errors.push(item);if(state.errors.length>80)state.errors.shift();emit('error',item);return item};
  const timeout=(promise,ms,label)=>Promise.race([Promise.resolve(promise),new Promise((_,rej)=>setTimeout(()=>rej(new Error('Timeout: '+label)),ms))]);
  const callMaybe=(fn,args)=>typeof fn==='function'?fn(...args):undefined;
  function makeFeature(def){
    const id=String(def.id||'feature-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2));
    if(state.features.has(id)) throw new Error('Feature already registered: '+id);
    const f={...def,id,state:'registered',errors:0,failures:0,retries:0,startedAt:null,lastError:null,lastErrorAt:null,quarantined:false,previousMode:null,timeoutMs:Math.max(250,Number(def.timeoutMs)||7000),maxFailures:Math.max(1,Number(def.maxFailures)||3),cooldownMs:Math.max(1000,Number(def.cooldownMs)||15000),enabled:def.enabled!==false,experimental:def.experimental===true,version:def.version||'1.0.0'};
    f.health={lastDurationMs:null,lastSuccessAt:null,lastFailureAt:null};f.circuit='closed';f.circuitOpenedAt=null;f.snapshot=null;
    state.features.set(id,f);
    if(typeof f.snapshot==='function')try{f._snapshot=f.snapshot(api,f)}catch(e){recordError(id,e,'snapshot')}
    if(f.enabled && (!f.experimental || state.mode==='experimental')) queueMicrotask(()=>api.enableFeature(id));
    return f;
  }
  async function initFeature(f){
    if(f.state==='ready'||f.state==='starting') return true;
    if(f.circuit==='open'){if(now()-f.circuitOpenedAt<f.cooldownMs){f.state='circuit-open';return false}f.circuit='half-open';f.state='half-open';}
    if(f.quarantined||!f.enabled) return false;
    if(f.experimental && state.mode!=='experimental'){f.state='gated';return false;}
    f.state='starting'; f.startedAt=now(); const t=now();
    try{await timeout(callMaybe(f.init,[api,f]),f.timeoutMs,f.id+'.init');f.state='ready';f.failures=0;f.circuit='closed';f.circuitOpenedAt=null;f.health.lastDurationMs=now()-t;f.health.lastSuccessAt=now();emit('ready',f);return true}
    catch(e){return failFeature(f,e,'init')}
  }
  async function destroyFeature(f,reason){
    if(!f||f.state==='destroyed'||f.state==='registered'||f.state==='gated') return true;
    try{await timeout(callMaybe(f.destroy,[api,f,reason]),f.timeoutMs,f.id+'.destroy');f.state='destroyed';emit('destroyed',{id:f.id,reason});return true}
    catch(e){recordError(f.id,e,'destroy');f.state='degraded';return false}
  }
  async function failFeature(f,e,phase){
    f.errors++;f.failures++;f.lastError=String(e?.message||e);f.lastErrorAt=now();f.health.lastFailureAt=now();recordError(f.id,e,phase);emit('failure',f);
    if(f.failures>=f.maxFailures){f.circuit='open';f.circuitOpenedAt=now();f.quarantined=true;f.state='quarantined';await destroyFeature(f,'quarantine');emit('quarantine',f);return false}
    f.state='degraded';
    if(f.retryOnError!==false){f.retries++;setTimeout(()=>{if(!f.quarantined&&f.enabled)initFeature(f)},Math.min(5000,500*f.retries));}
    return false;
  }
  const api={
    runtimeVersion:state.runtimeVersion,
    registerFeature:makeFeature,
    registerTab:(d)=>{if(!d?.id)throw new Error('Tab id required');state.tabs.set(String(d.id),d);emit('tab-registered',d);return d},
    registerAction:(d)=>{if(!d?.id)throw new Error('Action id required');state.actions.set(String(d.id),d);emit('action-registered',d);return d},
    registerWidget:(d)=>{if(!d?.id)throw new Error('Widget id required');state.widgets.set(String(d.id),d);emit('widget-registered',d);return d},
    registerTheme:(d)=>{if(!d?.id)throw new Error('Theme id required');state.themes.set(String(d.id),d);emit('theme-registered',d);return d},
    on,
    async enableFeature(id){const f=state.features.get(String(id));if(!f)return false;f.enabled=true;if(f.quarantined)return false;return initFeature(f)},
    async disableFeature(id,reason='manual'){const f=state.features.get(String(id));if(!f)return false;f.enabled=false;f.quarantined=false;return destroyFeature(f,reason)},
    async restartFeature(id){const f=state.features.get(String(id));if(!f)return false;f.quarantined=false;f.failures=0;f.retries=0;f.enabled=true;await destroyFeature(f,'restart');f.state='registered';return initFeature(f)},
    unquarantine(id){const f=state.features.get(String(id));if(!f)return false;f.quarantined=false;f.failures=0;f.circuit='half-open';f.circuitOpenedAt=now()-f.cooldownMs;f.state='registered';return true},
    async rollbackFeature(id){const f=state.features.get(String(id));if(!f)return false;if(typeof f.snapshot!=='function'||typeof f.restore!=='function')return false;try{await destroyFeature(f,'rollback');await timeout(Promise.resolve(f.restore(f._snapshot,api,f)),f.timeoutMs,String(id)+'.restore');f.state='ready';f.circuit='closed';f.quarantined=false;f.failures=0;return true}catch(e){return failFeature(f,e,'rollback')}},
    setMode(mode){mode=mode==='experimental'?'experimental':'stable';state.mode=mode;localStorage.setItem(KEY+':mode',mode);emit('mode',mode);state.features.forEach(f=>{if(f.experimental){if(mode==='experimental'&&f.enabled)initFeature(f);else if(mode==='stable'&&f.state==='ready')destroyFeature(f,'mode-change')}});render();return mode},
    getMode:()=>state.mode,
    getFeature:(id)=>state.features.get(String(id))||null,
    diagnostics(){return {runtimeVersion:state.runtimeVersion,mode:state.mode,uptimeMs:now()-state.startedAt,features:[...state.features.values()].map(f=>({id:f.id,version:f.version,state:f.state,experimental:f.experimental,enabled:f.enabled,quarantined:f.quarantined,circuit:f.circuit,circuitOpenedAt:f.circuitOpenedAt,errors:f.errors,failures:f.failures,retries:f.retries,lastError:f.lastError,lastErrorAt:f.lastErrorAt,health:f.health})),errors:state.errors.slice(-30),counts:{tabs:state.tabs.size,actions:state.actions.size,widgets:state.widgets.size,themes:state.themes.size}}},
    safe(id,fn,opts={}){const f=state.features.get(String(id));const ms=Math.max(250,Number(opts.timeoutMs||f?.timeoutMs||7000));return timeout(Promise.resolve().then(fn),ms,String(id)+'.safe').catch(e=>{if(f)failFeature(f,e,'safe');else recordError(id,e,'safe');return undefined})}
  };
  window.HawkPanel=api;
  function addRuntimeUi(){
    if(document.getElementById('hawk-runtime-fab'))return;
    const b=document.createElement('button');b.id='hawk-runtime-fab';b.type='button';b.innerHTML='<span>🛡️</span><span>Runtime</span>';b.title='Hawk Extension Runtime';b.onclick=()=>{document.getElementById('hawk-runtime-modal')?.classList.add('open');render()};document.body.appendChild(b);
    const m=document.createElement('div');m.id='hawk-runtime-modal';m.innerHTML='<div id="hawk-runtime-card"><div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:18px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-border,#334155)"><div><div style="font-weight:900;font-size:18px">Hawk Runtime</div><div style="opacity:.62;font-size:11px;margin-top:4px">Extension safety & health</div></div><button id="hawk-runtime-close" type="button" style="font-size:22px;padding:4px 9px;background:transparent;border:0;color:inherit">×</button></div><div style="padding:16px 20px"><div id="hawk-runtime-summary" style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:14px"></div><div id="hawk-runtime-list" style="display:grid;gap:8px"></div><div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:16px"><button id="hawk-runtime-mode" type="button" style="padding:9px 12px;border-radius:11px;border:1px solid var(--color-border,#334155);background:transparent;color:inherit">Experimental: OFF</button><button id="hawk-runtime-copy" type="button" style="padding:9px 12px;border-radius:11px;border:1px solid var(--color-border,#334155);background:transparent;color:inherit">Copy Diagnostics</button><button id="hawk-runtime-rollback" type="button" style="padding:9px 12px;border-radius:11px;border:1px solid var(--color-border,#334155);background:transparent;color:inherit">Rollback Snapshot</button><button id="hawk-runtime-recover" type="button" style="padding:9px 12px;border-radius:11px;border:1px solid var(--color-border,#334155);background:transparent;color:inherit">Recover Quarantined</button></div></div></div>';document.body.appendChild(m);
    document.getElementById('hawk-runtime-close').onclick=()=>m.classList.remove('open');m.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===m)m.classList.remove('open')});
    document.getElementById('hawk-runtime-mode').onclick=()=>api.setMode(state.mode==='experimental'?'stable':'experimental');
    document.getElementById('hawk-runtime-copy').onclick=async()=>{try{await navigator.clipboard.writeText(safeJson(api.diagnostics()));}catch(e){recordError('runtime',e,'clipboard')}};
    document.getElementById('hawk-runtime-rollback').onclick=()=>{state.features.forEach(f=>{if(f.quarantined&&typeof f.snapshot==='function'&&typeof f.restore==='function')api.rollbackFeature(f.id)});render()};
    document.getElementById('hawk-runtime-recover').onclick=()=>{state.features.forEach(f=>{if(f.quarantined){api.unquarantine(f.id);api.enableFeature(f.id)}});render()};
    render();
  }
  function render(){const m=document.getElementById('hawk-runtime-modal');if(!m)return;const d=api.diagnostics();const s=document.getElementById('hawk-runtime-summary');const l=document.getElementById('hawk-runtime-list');if(s)s.innerHTML='<span class="hawk-runtime-pill hawk-runtime-ok">CORE '+(d.runtimeVersion||'1')+'</span><span class="hawk-runtime-pill '+(d.mode==='experimental'?'hawk-runtime-warn':'hawk-runtime-ok')+'">'+d.mode.toUpperCase()+'</span><span class="hawk-runtime-pill">'+d.features.length+' features</span><span class="hawk-runtime-pill '+(d.errors.length?'hawk-runtime-warn':'hawk-runtime-ok')+'">'+d.errors.length+' errors</span>';if(l)l.innerHTML=d.features.length?d.features.map(f=>{const cls=f.quarantined?'hawk-runtime-bad':(f.state==='ready'?'hawk-runtime-ok':'hawk-runtime-warn');return '<div class="hawk-runtime-row"><div><strong>'+String(f.id).replace(/[<>]/g,'')+'</strong><small style="display:block;opacity:.55">v'+String(f.version).replace(/[<>]/g,'')+(f.experimental?' · experimental':'')+(f.lastError?' · '+String(f.lastError).replace(/[<>]/g,''):'')+' · circuit '+String(f.circuit)+'</small></div><span class="hawk-runtime-pill '+cls+'">'+String(f.state).toUpperCase()+'</span><small style="opacity:.55">'+f.errors+' err</small></div>'}).join(''):'<div style="opacity:.55;text-align:center;padding:25px">No registered extensions yet. Core panel remains untouched.</div>';const mb=document.getElementById('hawk-runtime-mode');if(mb)mb.textContent='Experimental: '+(state.mode==='experimental'?'ON':'OFF')}
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',addRuntimeUi,{once:true});else addRuntimeUi();
})();
</script>

      <script>
          function parseImportBindings(importStr) {
              const cleanStr = importStr.replace(/\/\/.*$/gm, '').replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, '').trim();
              const content = cleanStr
                  .replace(/^import\s+/, '')
                  .replace(/\s+from\s+["'].*?["'];?$/, '')
                  .trim();

              const bindings = [];

              if (content.startsWith('*')) {
                  const match = content.match(/\*\s+as\s+(\w+)/);
                  if (match) bindings.push({ name: match[1], isNamespace: true });
                  return bindings;
              }

              const braceStart = content.indexOf('{');
              if (braceStart !== -1) {
                  const defaultPart = content.slice(0, braceStart).replace(/,/, '').trim();
                  if (defaultPart) {
                      bindings.push({ name: defaultPart, isDefault: true });
                  }
                  const bracePart = content.slice(braceStart + 1, content.lastIndexOf('}')).trim();
                  const namedImports = bracePart.split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
                  namedImports.forEach(item => {
                      if (item.includes(' as ')) {
                          const parts = item.split(/\s+as\s+/);
                           bindings.push({ name: parts[1], original: parts[0] });
                      } else {
                          bindings.push({ name: item });
                      }
                  });
              } else {
                  bindings.push({ name: content, isDefault: true });
              }

              return bindings;
          }

          function obfuscateCode(srcText) {
              const importRegex = /import\s+[\s\S]*?from\s+["'].*?["'];?/g;
              const imports = [];
              let match;

              while ((match = importRegex.exec(srcText)) !== null) {
                  imports.push(match[0]);

          function renderChangelog(version) {
              const container = document.getElementById('modal-changelog-container');
              if (!container) return;

              const data = CHANGELOG_DATA[version];
              if (!data) {
                  container.innerHTML = '<p class="text-slate-400 text-xs">' + (i18n[lang]?.no_changelog || 'No changelog available for this version.') + '</p>';
                  return;
              }

              const t = (key) => i18n[lang]?.[key] || i18n['en']?.[key] || key;
              let html = '';

              if (data.headline) {
                  const headlineEl = document.getElementById('modal-version-headline');
                  if (headlineEl) headlineEl.textContent = data.headline[lang] || data.headline['en'];
              }

              const sections = [
                  { key: 'added', icon: '✨', color: 'emerald', items: data.added },
                  { key: 'fixed', icon: '🔧', color: 'blue', items: data.fixed },
                  { key: 'improved', icon: '⚡', color: 'violet', items: data.improved },
                  { key: 'changed', icon: '🔄', color: 'amber', items: data.changed },
                  { key: 'note', icon: '⚠️', color: 'red', items: data.notes },
              ];

              sections.forEach(section => {
                  if (section.items && section.items.length > 0) {
                      html += '<div class="mb-4">';
                      html += '<div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">';
                      html += '<span class="text-sm">' + section.icon + '</span>';
                      html += '<h5 class="text-xs font-bold text-' + section.color + '-600 dark:text-' + section.color + '-400 uppercase tracking-wider">' + t('changelog_' + section.key) + '</h5>';
                      html += '</div>';
                      html += '<div class="space-y-1.5 ps-6">';
                      section.items.forEach(item => {
                          html += '<div class="flex items-start gap-2">';
                          html += '<span class="text-' + section.color + '-400 mt-1.5">•</span>';
                          html += '<span class="text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">' + (item[lang] || item['en']) + '</span>';
                          html += '</div>';
                      });
                      html += '</div></div>';
                  }
              });

              container.innerHTML = html || '<p class="text-slate-400 text-xs">' + (i18n[lang]?.no_changes || 'No changes documented.') + '</p>';
          }

          let lang = localStorage.getItem('lang') || 'fa';
          let sessionKey = "", baseRoute = window.location.pathname.split('/dash')[0];
          let hostName = window.location.hostname, localUUID = "";

          window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
              let savedSession = localStorage.getItem('hawk_session');
              if (savedSession) {
                  try {
                      let parsed = JSON.parse(savedSession);
                      if (parsed && parsed.expiry && Date.now() < parsed.expiry) {
                           sessionKey = parsed.key;
                           doLogin(true).then(() => loadDashboard());
                      } else {
                          localStorage.removeItem('hawk_session');
                      }
                  } catch(e){}
              }
              checkVersionPopup();
          });

          function applyLang() {
              document.documentElement.dir = lang === 'fa' ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'; document.documentElement.lang = lang;
              document.getElementById('lang-toggle').innerText = lang === 'fa' ? 'EN' : 'فا';
              document.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n]').forEach(el => {
                  const key = el.getAttribute('data-i18n');
                  if (i18n[lang] && i18n[lang][key] !== undefined && i18n[lang][key] !== null) {
                      if (el.tagName === 'INPUT' || el.tagName === 'TEXTAREA') {
                          el.placeholder = i18n[lang][key];
                      } else {
                          if (key.startsWith('html_') || /<[a-z][\s\S]*>/i.test(i18n[lang][key])) {
                              el.innerHTML = i18n[lang][key];
                          } else {
                              el.innerText = i18n[lang][key];
                          }
                      }
                  }
              });
              document.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n-placeholder]').forEach(el => {
                  const key = el.getAttribute('data-i18n-placeholder');
                  if (i18n[lang] && i18n[lang][key] !== undefined && i18n[lang][key] !== null) {
                      el.placeholder = i18n[lang][key];
                  }
              });
              const gbUnit = i18n[lang]?.ov_gb_unit || 'GB';
              ['ov-total-traffic','ov-today-traffic'].forEach(id => {
                  const el = document.getElementById(id);
                  if (el && el.textContent.trim() === '- GB') el.textContent = '- ' + gbUnit;
              });
              const statTrafficEl = document.getElementById('stat-total-traffic');
              if (statTrafficEl && statTrafficEl.textContent.trim() === '0 GB') statTrafficEl.textContent = '0 ' + gbUnit;
          }
          function toggleLang() {
              lang = lang === 'fa' ? 'en' : 'fa';
              localStorage.setItem('lang', lang);
              applyLang();
              updateTitle();
              updateUI();
              try {
                  const m = document.getElementById('modal-version-update');
                  if (m && !m.classList.contains('hidden')) {
                      renderChangelog(CURRENT_VERSION);
                  }
              } catch(e){}
              try { renderUsersTable(); } catch(e){}
              try { renderLinkedNodes(); } catch(e){}
              try { renderFakeConfigs(window._fakeConfigs); } catch(e){}
          }
          applyLang();

          if (localStorage.getItem('theme') === 'dark' || (!('theme' in localStorage) && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches)) {
              document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
          } else {
              document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');
          }

          function toggleTheme() {
              document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark');
              localStorage.setItem('theme', document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') ? 'dark' : 'light');
          }

          function checkVersionPopup() {
              const popupKey = `hawk_shown_v__CURRENT_VERSION__`;
              if (!localStorage.getItem(popupKey)) {
                  setTimeout(() => {
                      const badge = document.getElementById('modal-version-badge');
                      if (badge) badge.textContent = 'v' + CURRENT_VERSION;
                      renderChangelog(CURRENT_VERSION);
                      const m = document.getElementById('modal-version-update');
                      if (m) {
                          m.classList.remove('hidden');
                          m.classList.add('flex');
                      }
                  }, 800);
              }
          }

          function closeVersionModal() {
              const m = document.getElementById('modal-version-update');
              if (m) {
                  m.classList.add('hidden');
                  m.classList.remove('flex');
              }
              const popupKey = `hawk_shown_v__CURRENT_VERSION__`;
              localStorage.setItem(popupKey, 'true');
          }

          function updateTitle() {
              const activeTab = document.querySelector('.nav-item.active span');
              if(activeTab) document.getElementById('view-title').innerText = activeTab.innerText;
          }

          let dashboardInterval = null;
          let networkInterval = null;
          function switchTab(tab) {
            ['overview','info','network','settings','advanced','logs','users','help'].forEach(t => {
                  const view = document.getElementById('view-'+t);
                  const deskBtn = document.getElementById('tab-'+t);
                  const mobBtn = document.getElementById('mob-tab-'+t);
                  if (tab === t) {
                      view.classList.remove('hidden'); view.classList.add('block', 'fade-in');
                      if(deskBtn) deskBtn.classList.add('active');
                      if(mobBtn) mobBtn.classList.add('active');
                  } else {
                      view.classList.add('hidden'); view.classList.remove('block', 'fade-in');
                      if(deskBtn) deskBtn.classList.remove('active');
                      if(mobBtn) mobBtn.classList.remove('active');
                  }
              });
            document.getElementById('view-add-user').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('view-edit-user').classList.add('hidden');
            var sc = document.querySelector('.scroll-content');
            if (sc) {
                sc.style.overflow = '';
                sc.classList.remove('flex', 'flex-col');
                if (sc.firstElementChild) sc.firstElementChild.classList.remove('flex-1', 'min-h-0', 'flex', 'flex-col');
                sc.scrollTop = 0;
            }
            updateTitle();
            
            if(dashboardInterval) { clearInterval(dashboardInterval); dashboardInterval = null; }
            if(networkInterval) { clearInterval(networkInterval); networkInterval = null; }
            
            if(tab === 'overview') {
                loadDashboard();
                dashboardInterval = setInterval(loadDashboard, 15000);
            }
            if(tab === 'logs') loadLogs();
            if(tab === 'network') {
                doLogin(true);
                networkInterval = setInterval(()=>doLogin(true), 15000);
            }
          }

        function toggleFAQ(button) {
            const content = button.nextElementSibling;
            const svg = button.querySelector('svg');
            if (content.classList.contains('hidden')) {
                content.classList.remove('hidden');
                svg.classList.add('rotate-180');
            } else {
                content.classList.add('hidden');
                svg.classList.remove('rotate-180');
            }
        }

        function filterFAQs() {
            const query = document.getElementById('faq-search').value.toLowerCase();
            const items = document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item');
            items.forEach(item => {
                const text = item.textContent.toLowerCase();
                if (text.includes(query)) {
                    item.classList.remove('hidden');
                } else {
                    item.classList.add('hidden');
                }
            });
        }

        async function loadLogs() {
            const container = document.getElementById('logs-container');
            if(!container) return;
            container.innerHTML = '<p class="text-sm text-slate-400 text-center py-4">' + (i18n[lang]?.loading_logs || 'Loading logs...') + '</p>';
            try {
                const res = await fetch(baseRoute + '/api/logs', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ key: sessionKey }) });
                const data = await res.json();
                if (data.success && data.logs) {
                    if (data.logs.length === 0) {
                        container.innerHTML = '<p class="text-sm text-slate-400 text-center py-4">' + (i18n[lang]?.no_activity_logs || 'No activity logs found.') + '</p>';
                        return;
                    }
                    let logsHtml = '';
                    data.logs.forEach(log => {
                        const dateStr = new Date(log.ts).toLocaleString('en-US', {hour12: false});
                        logsHtml += `<div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between p-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-xl border border-slate-100 dark:border-darkborder/50 gap-2"><div><p class="text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">${log.type}</p><p class="text-xs text-slate-500 truncate max-w-[200px] sm:max-w-xs" title="${log.detail}">${log.detail}</p></div><span class="text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-400 bg-[var(--color-surface)]  px-2 py-1 rounded shrink-0">${dateStr}</span></div>`;
                    });
                    container.innerHTML = logsHtml;
                } else {
                    container.innerHTML = '<p class="text-sm text-red-400 text-center py-4">Failed to load logs.</p>';
                }
            } catch (err) {
                container.innerHTML = '<p class="text-sm text-red-400 text-center py-4">Error loading logs.</p>';
            }
        }

        async function loadDashboard() {
            try {
                const [statsRes, logsRes] = await Promise.all([
                    fetch(baseRoute + '/api/stats', { method: 'GET', headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + sessionKey } }),
                    fetch(baseRoute + '/api/logs', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ key: sessionKey }) })
                ]);
                const statsData = await statsRes.json();
                const logsData = await logsRes.json();

                if (statsData.success && statsData.stats) {
                    const s = statsData.stats;
                    document.getElementById('ov-total-users').textContent = s.users.total;
                    document.getElementById('ov-active-users').textContent = s.users.active;
                    document.getElementById('ov-paused-users').textContent = s.users.paused;
                    document.getElementById('ov-auto-disabled').textContent = s.users.autoDisabled;
                    document.getElementById('ov-expired-users').textContent = s.users.expired;
                    document.getElementById('ov-total-traffic').textContent = s.traffic.totalGB + ' ' + (i18n[lang]?.ov_gb_unit || 'GB');
                    document.getElementById('ov-total-reqs').textContent = s.traffic.totalRequests.toLocaleString();
                    document.getElementById('ov-today-traffic').textContent = s.traffic.dailyGB + ' ' + (i18n[lang]?.ov_gb_unit || 'GB');
                    document.getElementById('ov-today-reqs').textContent = s.traffic.dailyRequests.toLocaleString();
                    document.getElementById('ov-active-conns').textContent = s.system.activeConnections;
                    
                    document.getElementById('ov-version').textContent = 'v' + s.system.version;
                    
                    const usageCont = document.getElementById('usage-metrics-container');
                    if(usageCont && statsData.stats.usage && window.hawkProfiles) {
                        let usageHtml = '';
                        window.hawkProfiles.forEach(p => {
                            let hash = p.id.replace(/-/g, '').toLowerCase();
                            let use = statsData.stats.usage[hash];
                            if(use) {

          // v1.2.4: one-click carrier presets for the fragment builder above.
          // Values are community-sourced starting points (not measured by
          // this project against real ISP DPI) — meant to save typing, not
          // as a guaranteed fix; the hint text under the buttons says so.
          const HAWK_FRAGMENT_PRESETS = {
              mci: { packets: 'tlshello', length: '10-30', delay: '2-5', maxSplit: '3' },
              mtn: { packets: 'tlshello', length: '100-200', delay: '5-10', maxSplit: '3' },
              rightel: { packets: 'tlshello', length: '50-100', delay: '2-5', maxSplit: '3' },
              mokhaberat: { packets: 'tlshello', length: '50-200', delay: '1-3', maxSplit: '3' },
              turbo: { packets: 'tlshello', length: '200-3000', delay: '1-2', maxSplit: '2' },
          };
          function applySegPreset(prefix, key) {
              const p = HAWK_FRAGMENT_PRESETS[key];
              if (!p) return;
              const setVal = (id, val) => {
                  const el = document.getElementById(id);
                  if (!el) return;
                  el.value = val;
                  el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
              };
              const modeEl = document.getElementById(prefix + '-user-seg-mode');
              if (modeEl) modeEl.value = 'builder';
              setVal(prefix + '-user-seg-packets', p.packets);
              setVal(prefix + '-user-seg-lengths', p.length);
              setVal(prefix + '-user-seg-delays', p.delay);
              setVal(prefix + '-user-seg-maxsplit', p.maxSplit);
              toggleSegMode(prefix);
              if (typeof showToast === 'function')
                  showToast((typeof lang !== 'undefined' && lang === 'fa' ? 'پیش‌فرض اعمال شد — ' : 'Preset applied — ') + key, 'info');
          }
          // Segmentation (fragment) UI: builder XOR manual, TLS mask optional.
          function toggleSegMode(prefix) {
              const modeEl = document.getElementById(prefix + '-user-seg-mode');
              const b = document.getElementById(prefix + '-user-seg-builder');
              const m = document.getElementById(prefix + '-user-seg-manual-wrap');
              const mode = modeEl ? modeEl.value : 'off';
              if (b) b.classList.toggle('hidden', mode !== 'builder');
              if (m) m.classList.toggle('hidden', mode !== 'manual');
          }
          function readSegRangeList(s) {
              const items = String(s || '').split(',').map(x => x.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 8);
              if (!items.length) return null;
              for (const it of items) { if (!/^\d{1,5}(-\d{1,5})?$/.test(it)) return null; }
              return items;
          }
          // Returns { ok:true, data } or { ok:false, err } (bilingual message).
          function validateSegForm(prefix) {
              const gv = (id) => { const el = document.getElementById(prefix + '-' + id); return el ? el.value.trim() : ''; };
              const mode = gv('user-seg-mode') || 'off';
              const tlsMask = gv('user-tls-mask');
              if (tlsMask && !/^(TLS_[A-Za-z0-9_]+)(:TLS_[A-Za-z0-9_]+)*$/.test(tlsMask))
                  return { ok: false, err: lang === 'fa' ? 'ماسک TLS معتبر نیست (مثل TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256:...)' : 'Invalid TLS mask (e.g. TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256:...)' };
              const out = { segMode: null, segPackets: null, segLengths: null, segDelays: null, segMaxSplit: null, segManual: null, tlsMask: tlsMask || null };
              if (mode === 'builder') {
                  const packets = gv('user-seg-packets');
                  const lengths = readSegRangeList(gv('user-seg-lengths'));
                  const delays = readSegRangeList(gv('user-seg-delays'));
                  const maxSplit = gv('user-seg-maxsplit');
                  if (!packets || (packets !== 'tlshello' && !/^\d{1,3}-\d{1,3}$/.test(packets)))
                      return { ok: false, err: lang === 'fa' ? 'بسته‌ها معتبر نیست (tlshello یا مثل 1-3)' : 'Invalid packets (tlshello or e.g. 1-3)' };
                  if (!lengths)
                      return { ok: false, err: lang === 'fa' ? 'اندازه‌ها معتبر نیست (مثل 5,94,1)' : 'Invalid lengths (e.g. 5,94,1)' };
                  if (!delays)
                      return { ok: false, err: lang === 'fa' ? 'تاخیرها معتبر نیست (مثل 0)' : 'Invalid delays (e.g. 0)' };
                  if (!/^\d{1,6}$/.test(maxSplit))
                      return { ok: false, err: lang === 'fa' ? 'سقف تکه معتبر نیست (عدد)' : 'Invalid maxSplit (number)' };
                  out.segMode = 'builder';
                  out.segPackets = packets;
                  out.segLengths = lengths.join(',');
                  out.segDelays = delays.join(',');
                  out.segMaxSplit = maxSplit;
                  return { ok: true, data: out };
              }
              if (mode === 'manual') {
                  const raw = gv('user-seg-manual');
                  if (!raw)
                      return { ok: false, err: lang === 'fa' ? 'متن دستی خالی است' : 'Manual text is empty' };
                  if (raw.charAt(0) === '{') {
                      try {
                          const obj = JSON.parse(raw);
                          if (!obj || typeof obj !== 'object' || !Array.isArray(obj.tcp) || !obj.tcp.length) throw 0;
                      } catch (e) {
                          return { ok: false, err: lang === 'fa' ? 'JSON معتبر نیست (باید {"tcp":[...]} باشد)' : 'Invalid JSON (must be {"tcp":[...]})' };
                      }
                  } else if (!/^\d{1,5}-\d{1,5},\d{1,5}-\d{1,5},(tlshello|\d{1,3}-\d{1,3})$/.test(raw)) {
                      return { ok: false, err: lang === 'fa' ? 'رشته کلاسیک معتبر نیست (مثل 200-3000,1-2,tlshello)' : 'Invalid classic string (e.g. 200-3000,1-2,tlshello)' };
                  }
                  out.segMode = 'manual';
                  out.segManual = raw;
                  return { ok: true, data: out };
              }
              return { ok: true, data: out };
          }

        wrap.innerHTML = '<span class="text-xs text-slate-400">' + (i18n[lang]?.no_ips_advanced || 'No IPs added in Advanced Tab') + '</span>';
        return;
    }
    const selArr = selectedIps ? selectedIps.split(',').map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean) : [];
    allIps.forEach(ip => {
        const lbl = document.createElement('label');
        lbl.className = "flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm cursor-pointer border border-slate-200 dark:border-darkborder px-2 py-1 rounded-lg";

function getGlobalNodeList() {
    var nodes = [];
    var lp = (window.hawkConfig && Array.isArray(window.hawkConfig.linkedPanels)) ? window.hawkConfig.linkedPanels : [];
    lp.forEach(function(p){
        var raw = (p && typeof p === 'object') ? (p.url || '') : (p || '');
        raw = String(raw).trim();
        if(!raw) return;
        raw = raw.replace(/^[a-zA-Z]+:\/\//, '').split('/')[0].split('@').pop();
        var h = raw.indexOf('[') === 0 ? raw.slice(0, raw.indexOf(']') + 1) : raw.split(':')[0];
        h = h.trim();
        if(h) nodes.push(h);
    });
    return nodes.filter(function(v,i,a){return a.indexOf(v) === i;});
}

          function buildModeCheckboxes(wrapId, userMode) {
              const globalMode = getGlobalMode();
              const alphaAllowed = globalMode === 'alpha' || globalMode === 'both';
              const betaAllowed = globalMode === 'beta' || globalMode === 'both';
              const selAlpha = userMode === 'alpha' || userMode === 'both' || (!userMode && alphaAllowed);
              const selBeta = userMode === 'beta' || userMode === 'both' || (!userMode && betaAllowed);
              const wrap = document.getElementById(wrapId);
              if (!wrap) return;
              wrap.querySelectorAll('input[type=checkbox]').forEach(cb => {
                  if (cb.value === 'alpha') { cb.disabled = !alphaAllowed; cb.checked = selAlpha && alphaAllowed; cb.closest			('label').style.opacity = alphaAllowed ? '1' : '0.35'; }
                  if (cb.value === 'beta')  { cb.disabled = !betaAllowed;  cb.checked = selBeta && betaAllowed;  cb.closest			('label').style.opacity = betaAllowed  ? '1' : '0.35'; }
              });
          }

             const cbs = [...document.querySelectorAll('.' + cbClass + ':checked')].map(c=>c.value);

              if (cbs.includes('alpha')) return 'alpha';

                  'chatgpt.com',

                  'digikala.com',
                  'divar.ir',
                  'cafebazaar.ir',
                  'shaparak.ir',
                  'aparat.com',
                  'soft98.ir',
                  'varzesh3.com'
              ];

              let resolvedIps = new Set();
              const cleanIpsTextarea = document.getElementById('cfg-ips');

              async function resolveOne(domain) {
                  try {
                      const res = await fetch(`https://cloudflare-dns.com/dns-query?name=${encodeURIComponent(domain)}&type=A`, {
                          headers: { 'accept': 'application/dns-json' }
                      });
                      const data = await res.json();
                      if (data && data.Answer) {
                          data.Answer.forEach(ans => {
                              if (ans.type === 1 && ans.data) {
                                  resolvedIps.add(ans.data);
                              }
                          });
                      }
                  } catch(e) {
                      try {
                          const res = await fetch(`https://dns.google/resolve?name=${encodeURIComponent(domain)}&type=A`);
                          const data = await res.json();
                          if (data && data.Answer) {
                              data.Answer.forEach(ans => {
                                  if (ans.type === 1 && ans.data) {
                                      resolvedIps.add(ans.data);
                                  }
                              });
                          }
                      } catch(ge) {}
                  }
              }

              try {
                  await Promise.all(domains.map(d => resolveOne(d)));
              } catch(err) {
                  console.error("DNS resolving process encountered an issue:", err);
              }

              if (resolvedIps.size > 0) {

              }

              btn.disabled = false;
              btn.innerHTML = origText;

          function parseMarkdown(md) {
              if (!md) return '';
              let lines = md.split(/\r?\n/);
              let htmlLines = [];
              let inCodeBlock = false;
              let codeContent = [];
              let activeBlockLang = null;

              for (let line of lines) {
                  let trimmed = line.trim();

                  if (trimmed === '<!-- LANG:EN -->' || trimmed === '<!--LANG:EN-->') {
                      if (activeBlockLang === 'en') {
                          activeBlockLang = null;
                      } else {
                          activeBlockLang = 'en';
                      }
                      continue;
                  }
                  if (trimmed === '<!-- LANG:FA -->' || trimmed === '<!--LANG:FA-->') {
                      if (activeBlockLang === 'fa') {
                          activeBlockLang = null;
                      } else {
                          activeBlockLang = 'fa';
                      }
                      continue;
                  }

                  if (activeBlockLang !== null && activeBlockLang !== lang) {
                      continue;
                  }

                  // Toggle code block
                  if (trimmed.startsWith('\x60\x60\x60')) {
                      if (inCodeBlock) {
                          // Close code block
                          let codeText = codeContent.join('\n')
                              .replace(/&/g, "&")
                              .replace(/</g, "<")
                              .replace(/>/g, ">");
                          htmlLines.push('<pre class="bg-slate-900/90 text-slate-100 p-3 rounded-xl my-2 font-mono text-[10px] overflow-x-auto border border-slate-800 max-h-40">' + codeText + '</pre>');
                          codeContent = [];
                          inCodeBlock = false;
                      } else {
                          inCodeBlock = true;
                      }
                      continue;
                  }

                  if (inCodeBlock) {
                      codeContent.push(line);
                      continue;
                  }

                  if (!trimmed) {
                      continue;
                  }

                  // Process headers
                  if (trimmed.startsWith('### ')) {
                      let text = trimmed.slice(4);
                      htmlLines.push('<h5 class="text-sm font-bold text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-400 mt-3 mb-1">' + parseInlineMarkdown(text) + '</h5>');
                      continue;
                  }
                  if (trimmed.startsWith('## ')) {
                      let text = trimmed.slice(3);
                      htmlLines.push('<h4 class="text-sm font-extrabold text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-400 mt-4 mb-2">' + parseInlineMarkdown(text) + '</h4>');
                      continue;
                  }
                  if (trimmed.startsWith('# ')) {
                      let text = trimmed.slice(2);
                      htmlLines.push('<h3 class="text-base font-black text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-300 mt-4 mb-2">' + parseInlineMarkdown(text) + '</h3>');
                      continue;
                  }

                  // Process lists
                  let listMatch = line.match(/^(\s*)([-*+])\s+(.*)$/);
                  if (listMatch) {
                      let text = listMatch[3];
                      htmlLines.push('<div class="flex items-start gap-2 my-1"><span class="text-amber-500 mt-0.5">▪</span><span class="flex-1">' + parseInlineMarkdown(text) + '</span></div>');
                      continue;
                  }

                  // Standard line
                  htmlLines.push('<p class="my-1">' + parseInlineMarkdown(line) + '</p>');
              }

              // Guard for unclosed code block
              if (inCodeBlock && codeContent.length > 0) {
                  let codeText = codeContent.join('\n')
                      .replace(/&/g, "&")
                      .replace(/</g, "<")
                      .replace(/>/g, ">");
                  htmlLines.push('<pre class="bg-slate-900/90 text-slate-100 p-3 rounded-xl my-2 font-mono text-[10px] overflow-x-auto border border-slate-800 max-h-40">' + codeText + '</pre>');
              }

              return htmlLines.join('\n');

              function parseInlineMarkdown(text) {
                  let safe = text
                      .replace(/&/g, "&")
                      .replace(/</g, "<")
                      .replace(/>/g, ">");
                  // Bold
                  safe = safe.replace(/\*\*(.*?)\*\*/g, '<strong class="font-extrabold text-[var(--color-text)]">$1</strong>');
                  // Italic
                  safe = safe.replace(/\*(.*?)\*/g, '<em class="italic">$1</em>');
                  // Inline code
                  safe = safe.replace(/[\x60](.*?)[\x60]/g, '<code class="bg-amber-500/10 dark:bg-slate-800 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-rose-500 font-mono text-[11px]">$1</code>');
                  return safe;
              }
          }

<script id="hawk-3d-glass-js">
(()=>{
  const KEY='hawk_glass_theme';
  const themes={
    ember:['#e8753d','#ffb05f'],copper:['#c8874a','#f1c38c'],aurora:['#d77cf0','#6ed8ff'],
    royal:['#8e7dff','#d5a9ff'],midnight:['#55c6c9','#9be9d8'],champagne:['#d5a85f','#ffe0a0']
  };
  const apply=(name,save=true)=>{
    const valid=themes[name]?name:'ember';
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-hawk-theme',valid);
    if(save) localStorage.setItem(KEY,valid);
    const sel=document.getElementById('theme-selector'); if(sel && themes[valid]) sel.value=valid;
    document.querySelectorAll('.hawk-theme-dot').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('is-active',x.dataset.theme===valid));
  };
  const addCards=()=>{
    document.body.classList.add('hawk-3d-ui');
    document.querySelectorAll('#dash-box .native-press').forEach(x=>x.classList.add('hawk-glass-card'));
    document.querySelectorAll('#dash-box .scroll-content .rounded-3xl').forEach(x=>{
      if(!x.closest('button') && !x.classList.contains('hawk-no-glass')) x.classList.add('hawk-glass-card');
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('#dash-box .scroll-content [id^="view-"] > div').forEach(x=>{
      if(!x.closest('button') && !x.classList.contains('hawk-no-glass')) x.classList.add('hawk-glass-card');
    });
  };
  const dock=()=>{
    if(document.querySelector('.hawk-theme-dock')) return;
    const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='hawk-theme-dock';d.setAttribute('aria-label','Hawk themes');
    Object.entries(themes).forEach(([name,c])=>{
      const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.className='hawk-theme-dot';b.dataset.theme=name;b.title=name[0].toUpperCase()+name.slice(1);
      b.style.background=`linear-gradient(135deg,${c[0]},${c[1]})`;b.addEventListener('click',()=>apply(name));d.appendChild(b);
    });
    document.body.appendChild(d);
  };
  const init=()=>{
    apply(localStorage.getItem(KEY)||'ember',false);
    const sel=document.getElementById('theme-selector');
    if(sel) sel.addEventListener('change',()=>{ if(themes[sel.value]) apply(sel.value); });
    addCards();dock();setTimeout(addCards,500);
  };
  if(document.readyState==='loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',init,{once:true}); else init();
  window.HawkGlassTheme={apply};
})();
</script>
